deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O5b Recovery sheet · print or save': the preview's header reads 'RUKKA · RECOVERY SHEET' (onboarding.recovery_sheet.pdf_title 'Rukka · recovery sheet', upper-cased at s0_5b_recovery_sheet_screen.dart:708) where O5b prints 'RUKKA FOLIO · RECOVERY SHEET'
deviations.reason: [screen] the frame is right: 01 §1 rule 4's carve-out 🔒 exempts the product name Rukka Folio wherever it appears as the name (export footers and printed pages included), so the app's shortened 'Rukka' is the deviation. Fixing it is a copy change outside this record (EN/PA/HI): check_strings.dart whitelists only app.name, app.name.short and about.*, so the title should take the name from app.name (an {appName} placeholder) rather than spell 'Folio' in an onboarding.* key — reported in open. The printed page carries the same title
deviations.authority: docs/01-glossary.md §1 rule 4 (carve-out 🔒: the product name is exempt); scripts/check_strings.dart whitelisted(); ADR 2026-10-05 §1

deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O5b Recovery sheet · print or save': Caption reads 'One A4 page · a square to scan, and a code to type if it won't scan' where O5b says 'eight characters to type'
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] 04 §7.4's typed fallback is Crockford Base32 of version ‖ user_id ‖ RK (49 bytes): 79 symbols + a 2-char checksum in groups of 4, not eight characters. ⚠️ SPEC: canvas c1/O5b, R2.4 and R2.4b all say 'eight characters' — the canvas copy conflicts with 04 §7.4; reported to the owner

deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O5b Recovery sheet · print or save': The heading 'Only you can open your books' wraps to two lines and the caption sits just below the fold at 390×844
deviations.reason: [screen] The frame draws the heading at ~24 pt; the page heading role in tokens.json is 28 pt (RkType.page), which wraps at this width. Everything else in the stack matches the frame's spacing. A failed make's reason is pinned directly above 'Try again' in the action area (outside the scrolling page), so it is on screen at 390×844 and 360×800 (captures S0.5b__not_made, __not_made__android360; F1-1006d-1 asserts it). Check results (R2.4b's causes) appear under the preview and are scrolled into view
deviations.authority: design/tokens/tokens.json (type roles); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (a canvas size maps to its type role)

deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O5b Recovery sheet · print or save': Buttons have the theme's rounded corners where O5b draws square ones
deviations.reason: [shared] primary button (FilledButton/OutlinedButton theme): Button shape is the shared theme's (app/lib/shared/theme.dart, RkRadius), not this screen's; every screen draws it so

deviations.what: Canvas 1 'O5b Recovery sheet · print or save': States the frame does not draw: not_made (reason pinned above Try again + Skip for now), check (Scan the sheet / Type the code instead / Make a new sheet), the in-progress line under the preview, and the Back re-entry in sign-up (opens on the 'opened' state; Print or save then asks before a new sheet voids the printed one)
deviations.reason: [screen] ADR 2026-10-06d ruling 3 requires a failed publish to show its reason and keep Skip; 04 §7.4's scan-back and regenerate need a check state. Drawn in O5b's layout; check takes R2.4's scan + 'type the code instead' pair and R2.4b's two failure causes
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-06d ruling 3 🔒; ADR 2026-10-07 ruling 1; 04 §7.4 🔒; 13 §4.3; canvas c1/R2.4, c1/R2.4b (pattern only); RUNG3B repair #1 (04 §7.4 🔒 a new sheet invalidates the old)
